items.title: Special termination right due to gas price increase
items.quote: Damit die Kündigung wirkt, muss sie bei uns vor dem Inkrafttreten der neuen Preise eingehen.
items.computation: The letter gives a fixed date for the price increase: 01.01.2027 (new Arbeitspreis 11,12 ct/kWh, new Abschlag 118,00 €, effective '01.01.2027' per 'Ihre Gaspreise ab 01.01.2027'). The special right to terminate without notice ('ohne Einhaltung einer Frist zum 01.01.2027') requires the cancellation to arrive at the provider before the new prices take effect, i.e. before 2027-01-01. The last calendar day before that is 2026-12-31, a Thursday, which is not a Saturday, Sunday or public holiday in NW (checked: Dec 25-26 are holidays, Dec 31 is not; Jan 1 2027 is a holiday but falls on/after the cutoff), so no weekend/holiday shift applies and the deadline stays 2026-12-31.
